title: User-Level Handover Decision Making Based on Machine Learning Approaches
abstract: arXiv:2609.22593v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This letter covers a broad comparison of methods for classification and regression applications for a user-level handover decision making in scenarios with adverse propagation conditions involving buildings, coverage holes, and shadowing effects. The simulation campaigns are based on network simulator ns-3. The comparison encompasses classical machine learning approaches, such as KNN, SVM, and neural networks, but also state-of-the-art fuzzy logic systems and latter boosting machines. The results indicate that SVM and MLP are the most suitable for the classification of the best handover target, although fuzzy system SOFL can perform similarly with lower processing time. Additionally, for the download time estimation, LightGBM provides the smallest error with short processing time, even in hard propagation scenarios.

translated_title: 基于机器学习方法的用户级切换决策
translated_abstract: 本短文对用户级切换决策中分类和回归应用的方法进行了广泛比较，涵盖涉及建筑物、覆盖空洞和阴影效应等不利传播条件的场景。仿真实验基于网络模拟器ns-3。该比较不仅包括经典机器学习方法，如KNN、SVM和神经网络，还包括最先进的模糊逻辑系统以及近期的提升机方法。结果表明，SVM和MLP最适合用于最佳切换目标的分类，而模糊系统SOFL能够以更低的处理时间实现相近的性能。此外，在下载时间估计方面，即使处于恶劣的传播场景中，LightGBM也能以较短的处理时间提供最小的误差。
tldr: 该论文基于ns-3仿真比较了多种机器学习方法在用户级切换决策中的表现，发现SVM和MLP最适合最佳切换目标分类（模糊系统SOFL性能相近且处理时间更短），而LightGBM在下载时间估计中误差最小且处理速度快。
en_tdlr: This paper broadly compares machine learning approaches for user-level handover decision making via ns-3 simulations, showing that SVM and MLP are best suited for classifying the optimal handover target (with the fuzzy system SOFL achieving similar performance at lower processing time), while LightGBM provides the smallest error for download time estimation even in challenging propagation scenarios.
